comment: Advisories that are ACCEPTED for now, checked by scripts/audit-allowlist.mjs.
An entry belongs here only when the fix is genuinely not ours to make. If a version
bump or an npm `overrides` entry can resolve it, do that instead — see shell-quote
in the root package.json for an example of the latter.
Every entry expires. On the expiry date CI fails and the exception has to be
re-argued: re-check upstream, then either fix it or extend the date with a fresh
reason. An entry that stops matching also fails, so a fixed advisory cannot sit here
pretending to be a live risk.
Fields: id (GHSA), package, directory (which audited tree it applies to), severity,
reason, blocker (why we cannot fix it), expires (YYYY-MM-DD), review (what to check).

allow.reason: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory crash. Reached only through @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent's bundled minimatch, expanding glob patterns we author ourselves — not attacker-supplied input.
allow.blocker: pi-coding-agent 0.83.0 (the latest published version) ships an npm-shrinkwrap.json pinning brace-expansion 5.0.7, and a dependency's shrinkwrap wins over a consumer's overrides, so neither `overrides` nor `npm dedupe` nor `npm audit fix` can move it. The advisory is patched in 5.0.8; the root's own copy is already at 5.0.9.
allow.review: Check for a pi-coding-agent release above 0.83.0 whose shrinkwrap carries brace-expansion >= 5.0.8.

allow.review: Check for a pi-coding-agent release above 0.83.0 whose shrinkwrap carries brace-expansion >= 5.0.9.
